Specialties:
- Cardiology: Heart and blood vessel conditions treated with medicines, angiography, angioplasty, stents and pacemakers
- Cardiothoracic Surgery: Surgery on the heart, lungs, chest and major blood vessels: bypass (CABG), valve repair or replacement, open heart surgery, aortic surgery
- Pediatric Cardiology: Heart conditions in babies and children, including congenital heart defects
- Oncology: Cancer diagnosis and treatment: chemotherapy, radiotherapy, immunotherapy and cancer surgery
- Hematology & Bone Marrow Transplant: Blood disorders and bone marrow transplant: leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma, thalassemia, anaemia, bleeding disorders
- Orthopaedics: Bones, joints, spine and sports injuries: fractures, joint replacement, arthritis, back pain
- Neurology: Brain, spinal cord and nerve conditions treated without surgery: stroke, epilepsy, migraine, Parkinson's, neuropathy
- Neurosurgery: Surgery of the brain, spine and nerves: brain tumours, aneurysms, spinal cord compression, hydrocephalus
- Gastroenterology: Stomach, intestines, liver, pancreas and gallbladder: acidity, ulcers, IBD, hepatitis, endoscopy
- Nephrology: Kidney disease treated medically: chronic kidney disease, dialysis, protein in urine
- Urology: Urinary tract and male reproductive organs: kidney stones, prostate, bladder problems
- Organ Transplant: Kidney, liver, heart and other organ transplants, including living donor transplants
- Obstetrics & Gynaecology: Pregnancy, childbirth and women's reproductive health: fibroids, ovarian cysts, menstrual problems, hysterectomy
- Reproductive Medicine: Infertility treatment: IVF, ICSI, IUI, egg freezing, male infertility
- Paediatrics: Medical care for babies, children and adolescents, including newborn care and development
- Endocrinology: Hormone and metabolic conditions: diabetes, thyroid, PCOS, obesity, growth and adrenal problems
- Pulmonology: Lung and breathing conditions: asthma, COPD, TB, pneumonia, sleep apnoea
- Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery: Reconstruction after burns, injury, cancer or birth defects, and cosmetic surgery
- Bariatric Surgery: Weight-loss surgery for severe obesity: gastric sleeve, gastric bypass, gastric balloon
- Emergency Medicine: Immediate care for accidents, injuries, poisoning and sudden life-threatening problems
- Critical Care: Intensive care (ICU) for critically ill patients: ventilator support, sepsis, multi-organ failure
- Ophthalmology: Eye conditions: cataract, glaucoma, retina problems, vision loss, eye infections
- ENT: Ear, nose and throat: hearing loss, sinus, tonsils, voice problems, cochlear implants
- Dermatology: Skin, hair and nail conditions: psoriasis, eczema, acne, vitiligo, fungal infections
- Psychiatry: Mental health: depression, anxiety, panic attacks, addiction, sleep and behaviour problems
- General Medicine: First point of care for common illness, fevers, infections and general check-ups when no specialty is clear
